The paediatrics department provides diagnosis and treatment for children from birth to 18 years of age, with outpatient clinics, an inpatient ward and intensive care areas designed for children. It is organised into a newborn section (0-28 days) and a child section (0-18 years), with subspecialties working together as a multidisciplinary team. MedLuxLife helps families access the right paediatric specialist at our partner hospital and coordinates appointments, travel and communication.

Treatments and services

General paediatric care

Outpatient, inpatient and intensive care services for children aged 0-18 in child-friendly settings.

Newborn care

The neonatal section serves babies up to 28 days old through a neonatal unit, a neonatal observation unit and a neonatal intensive care unit.

Breastfeeding support

The hospital follows the UNICEF and WHO Baby-Friendly approach, with specially trained staff helping mothers establish and maintain breastfeeding.

Paediatric allergy

Testing and treatment for allergic diseases, including skin tests, blood allergy tests, lung function tests, allergen provocation tests, food tests, anaesthetic drug tests and allergy vaccination (immunotherapy).

Paediatric endocrinology

Assessment of hormonal and metabolic problems such as growth disorders, diabetes, thyroid and puberty-related conditions.

Paediatric haematology-oncology

Diagnosis and treatment of blood diseases and childhood cancers, with outpatient and inpatient care in a paediatric bone marrow transplantation clinic.

Paediatric gastroenterology, hepatology and nutrition

Care for diseases of the oesophagus, stomach, duodenum, small and large intestine, liver and gallbladder, as well as nutritional disorders.

Paediatric surgery

Treatment of urological, genital, digestive and respiratory conditions and newborn anomalies, including non-cardiac thoracic, oncological, digestive and endocrine surgery, paediatric gynaecology, trauma surgery, diagnostic and interventional endoscopy, and laparoscopic and thoracoscopic procedures.

Paediatric nephrology

Diagnosis and treatment of congenital and acquired problems of the kidneys, urinary tract, bladder and urethra.

Paediatric rheumatology

Outpatient care for childhood rheumatic diseases affecting joints, muscles, blood vessels and skin.

Conditions treated

  • Asthma
  • Allergic bronchitis
  • Allergic rhinitis (hay fever)
  • Atopic dermatitis (eczema)
  • Urticaria (hives)
  • Food allergy
  • Drug allergy, including allergy to anaesthetic agents
  • Chronic cough
  • Wheezing in infants
  • Frequent respiratory tract infections
  • Allergic skin rashes
  • Growth retardation and short stature
  • Type 1 diabetes mellitus
  • Hypoglycaemia
  • Early or delayed puberty
  • Thyroid diseases (hypothyroidism, hyperthyroidism)
  • Pituitary gland diseases
  • Menstrual irregularities
  • Excessive hair growth
  • Disorders of sexual development
  • Adrenal gland diseases
  • Obesity
  • Leukaemia
  • Blood production disorders
  • Thalassaemia (Mediterranean anaemia)
  • Sickle cell disease
  • Bone marrow failure
  • Genetic diseases
  • Immune system diseases
  • Childhood tumours
  • Diseases of the oesophagus, stomach and intestines
  • Liver and gallbladder diseases
  • Nutritional disorders
  • Kidney and urinary tract disorders
  • Childhood rheumatic diseases

Before you travel

To get a reliable medical opinion quickly, please prepare:

  • Recent medical reports and discharge summaries
  • Imaging (MRI, CT, X-ray) on CD or as DICOM files, with the radiology reports
  • Recent laboratory results
  • A list of your current medications and any allergies
  • Child's vaccination record
  • Growth charts or previous paediatric reports

How MedLuxLife supports you

1. Free consultation

Tell us your wishes – we answer your questions, explain the options and arrange an online consultation with a specialist in Türkiye. Medical documents go directly to the doctor, only on request.

2. Personal treatment plan

Our partner specialists prepare a treatment plan and an estimated timeline tailored to you.

3. Travel & treatment

4. Aftercare
